title: Prediction Inference for Hybrid Models on Realized Volatility Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.13212v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GARCH-LSTM hybrid models have become increasingly popular in the volatility forecasting literature. To date, these models have almost exclusively focused on point estimation and accuracy measures such as RMSE and MAPE, while failing to assess the uncertainty of these point estimates. We approach this gap in two ways. First, we extend the existing GARCH-LSTM model by modeling the conditional mean with an ARMA structure. Second, we develop a forward bootstrap algorithm to build multi-step-ahead prediction intervals for future realized volatility. In order to address the notorious undercoverage of prediction intervals, we implement two solutions. One draws bootstrap innovations from the empirical residual distribution to mimic the fat-tail property of financial series. translated_title: 已实现波动率预测中混合模型的预测推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.13212v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：GARCH-LSTM 混合模型在波动率预测文献中日益流行。迄今为止，这些模型几乎完全专注于点估计以及诸如 RMSE 和 MAPE 之类的精度度量，而未能评估这些点估计的不确定性。我们从两个方面来填补这一空白。首先，我们通过用 ARMA 结构对条件均值进行建模，对现有的 GARCH-LSTM 模型进行了扩展。其次，我们开发了一种向前自助（forward bootstrap）算法，为未来的已实现波动率构建多步预测区间。为了解决预测区间普遍存在的覆盖率不足问题，我们实施了两项解决方案：一是从经验残差分布中抽取自助创新项（bootstrap innovations），以模仿金融序列的厚尾特性；二是利用共形预测（conformal prediction）的原理，系统地扩展预测区间的长度。我们在具有厚尾（的模拟环境中评估了这些方法）
tldr: 该论文通过在 GARCH-LSTM 混合模型中引入 ARMA 条件均值结构，并提出一种结合经验残差自助抽样与共形预测校正的向前自助算法，为已实现波动率构建了覆盖率更高的多步预测区间，弥补了现有方法忽视点估计不确定性的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the GARCH-LSTM hybrid model with an ARMA conditional mean and develops a forward bootstrap algorithm—enhanced with empirical residual innovations and conformal prediction calibration—to construct well-calibrated multi-step-ahead prediction intervals for realized volatility.
